label: January 2020 HEP small-team pilot + selected author records
description: INSPIRE works with January 2020 arXiv identifiers, a hep-ph or hep-th category (including cross-lists), and at most 10 listed authors; bounded most-cited works for selected modern and historical researchers; one ATLAS discovery paper for large-team coverage testing. Author profiles and doctoral evidence are a selected subset. This is not all of HEP and no researcher's full neighborhood is claimed complete.
